# Test fixtures

Sample input files used by the test suite. Treat these as part of the
contract: if a fixture is changed, every test using it needs review.

## Layout

    fixtures/
      synthetic/   small generated CAN logs with known, deterministic content
      real/        comma2k19 driving log segments converted to ASC format
      dbcs/        DBC files used for testing signal decoding

## Synthetic fixtures

Generated by `src/generate_log.py` (or extensions of it) and have small,
controlled content suitable for unit tests with exact assertions.

Planned fixtures:

| File | Description | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| `tiny.asc` | 5 frames, single channel, all Rx | Smoke test |
| `multi_channel.asc` | Frames on channels 1, 2, 3 | Verify Bug #3 fix |
| `with_tx_frames.asc` | Mix of Rx and Tx frames | Verify Bug #1 fix |
| `with_error_frames.asc` | Includes ErrorFrame entries | Verify Bug #1 fix |
| `extended_ids.asc` | 29-bit CAN IDs marked with `x` suffix | Verify Bug #1 fix |
| `empty.asc` | Empty file | Verify graceful handling |
| `header_only.asc` | Header lines only, no frames | Verify graceful handling |
| `malformed.asc` | Lines with corrupt format | Verify error handling |

These will be added as the test suite is built out.

## Real fixtures

Real driving data sourced from comma.ai's open datasets. See
`real/README.md` for attribution and license information.

Note: comma2k19 ships in capnp format, not ASC. A conversion script
(to be added) extracts CAN frames and writes them as ASC for use by
the parser tests.

## DBC fixtures

DBC files used by tests. The production `data/dbcs/toyota.dbc` is the
default for many tests, but some tests need controlled minimal DBCs.

Planned fixtures:

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `minimal.dbc` | Three messages, simple signals, for unit tests |
| `multi_message.dbc` | Many messages, varied byte orders and sizes |

These will be added as the test suite is built out.
